title: strict-authoring-face-8345 test walks the repo with an unguarded readFileSync and races tsup temp bundles (queue flake)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpFBMr917PmVkG9up7

Filing gate: ① (a test defect with a named site and a CI reproduction; it can red the merge queue for any PR).

## Business reason

The merge queue runs the full suite, and every red queue build rebuilds every PR queued behind it. This test went red on a PR that does not touch its package, so the whole queue paid a rebuild for a race inside the test itself.

## Reproduction

Queue build https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41962914067, job `Test UI (4/16)`, on PR #30242. That PR touches only `ui/packages/app-shell` and `ui/packages/plugin-list`:

```
FAIL  unit  packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts > the barrel is the sole entry into the module cycle > no module in this repository imports the deep module except the barrel
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/home/runner/work/objectstack/objectstack/ui/packages/create-plugin/tsup.config.bundled_xhmfdr22t5.mjs'
```

## Site

`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts:546-553` on `origin/main`. `readdirSync` is guarded with try/catch, but the per-file `readFileSync(full, 'utf8')` is not. tsup writes and deletes a transient `tsup.config.bundled_*.mjs` beside a package's config while another shard builds. The walker lists the file, and it is gone before the read.

## Same family (closed)

#20225 (`check-error-status-conformance.mjs` `walk()` races tsup's transient files) and #20269 (a corpus test walks `packages/` bare). Those fixes guard the read, or skip `tsup.config.bundled_*`. This is a new site of the same family.

## Reader who acts

Triage routes this card. The file is a ui package test, so the expected lane is `domain:ui`. The fix is one guard in the walker; the assertion must not be weakened.

## Dedupe (open and closed)

`strict-authoring-face-8345 is:issue`: 17 hits, none about this walker. `tsup.config.bundled ENOENT is:issue`: 7 hits, the closed family above. **New site.**

## Re-check

`git grep -n "if (SPECIFIER.test(readFileSync(full" origin/main -- ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts`
